summary: Apimeds Pharmaceuticals US, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a confidential settlement and mutual release agreement resolving disputes from a prior merger agreement. The settlement allows Lokahi Therapeutics, a subsidiary, to retain the Apitox program assets and intellectual property, and provides a $4 million working capital contribution to the company. Lokahi will forgive $750,000 in advances. The company will distribute 51% of Lokahi's common stock to a former CEO and retain 49%. A new wholly owned subsidiary will be formed. This is a litigation settlement and internal reorganization, not a special situation transaction with external deal terms.
